about: West 25th Laundry & Dry Clean is at 502 W William Joel Bryan Pkwy in Bryan.
It's family-owned, run by a Texas A&M graduate, and has served the community since opening on March 11, 1972. Reviewers say what sets it apart is heavy starch, and the starch is homemade.
Customers have given it 4.8 stars across 23 Google reviews.
